name: decode-only-wrapper
description: A function that only decodes into its argument, a method of a module outside the analyzed program that hands its argument to a standard decoder and to nothing else, is a decoding destination: it reads no field of the decoded type and resolves no method of it but the decoding ones, so a field only it fills and a method nothing calls are reported. A method whose name says it decodes and that also prints its argument is a destination outside the analyzed program, which resolves the methods its package can name and fills every field the program does not write, so such a field the program never reads is reported at the reachability class possible.
